# Verko

> Verko is a video editor and motion designer. This is Verko's portfolio: selected reels, kinetic typography, UI and app motion, and product callouts.

## Work
- [Everything in One Place](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DXRaubCDVdt/): kinetic text
- [Anytime.](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DXwwWVitb6l/): gradient and type
- [Reservation Confirmed](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DYTt5kftd4m/): text and UI reveal
- [Let’s Work Together](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DXTYIhejXve/): prompt bar and UI motion
- [Hero Sensor Callouts](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DgB_rb5A04J/): product tracking and callouts
- [Not “Automation”](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DZ2NHD7t6Wx/): icon callouts

## Services
- Video editing: reels, short-form and promos
- Motion graphics: kinetic typography, logo and title animation, UI and app motion

## Tools
Alight Motion, Keyflow, Ibis Paint X, PicsArt
